text:
alex: starting deploy service=route-service v=4.2.1 in eu-west. plan: phased FF ramp 5% -> 25% -> 75% with 8m quiet windows. tracking: latency, 5xx, model_regression_score. who owns realtime checks?
maria: i'll watch infra metrics + 5xx. nina take model regression?
nina: on it. i'll run eval set after each step and report drift.
deploybot: [auto] deploy queued svc=route-service version=4.2.1 region=eu-west canary=true
kai: recommend sticky=false for this one (it's stateless routing), reduces cohort bleed. also set /ff auto-roll=false to prevent CI bot flips.
alex: going 5% now:
```
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=5 --note="initial canary eu-west"
```
ops-bot: routing update applied, canary=5%, sticky=false, autoscale check OK.
deploybot: canary traffic healthy: 50/50 success, p95=210ms, 5xx=0.1%
nina: eval1: model_regression_score delta=+0.2% (within threshold 0.5%). no obvious hallucination on test prompts.
(8 minutes)
alex: ramp to 25%
```
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=25 --note="post-canary ramp"
```
ops-bot: ramp applied -> 25%
maria: infra looks stable. no latency spikes. streaming logs show some tokenization WARNs but no errors.
nina: eval2: delta=0.9% (threshold 0.5%) — that's higher than expected, seeing degradation on safety prompts and some repetition.
alex: that's past threshold. what's the user-visible signal?
maria: small uptick in response truncation and a few customer-facing retries in eu-west. global impact minimal so far, but trend is worrying.
kai: option A: soft-drain and pin to 0% then rollback. Option B: full immediate rollback to 4.2.0 while keeping FF unpinned (gives devs chance to hotfix). What's team preference?
nina: strongly for immediate rollback. we have failing prompts to reproduce.
alex: agree. implement soft-drain first to stop new canary sessions then rollback. jordan? (not in channel)
deploybot: initiating soft-drain: will stop routing new sessions to v4.2.1, existing requests finish.
ops-bot: executing FF pin:
```
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=0 --pin=true --note="pin after quality drift"
```
ops-bot: pin applied.
deploybot: performing rollback to version=4.2.0 -- reason="quality regression"
deploybot: rollback complete. traffic now on v4.2.0.
maria: infra stable post-rollback. will keep watch for 15m.
nina: adding failing examples to the regression suite and filing a follow-up ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-4521
alex: schedule re-eval + preflight for v4.2.1 patch tomorrow 10:00 UTC. add any extra automated checks to the runbook.
ops-bot: note: set FF cooldown=30m before next ramp per policy.
sam: thanks all. remind oncall to mute alert noise for this event. :white_check_mark:
